People With Glasses Be Like 👓😂 — Part 10!

Honey goes to the eye doctor for a simple eye check-up… but somehow ends up more interested in the clinic equipment, the doctor’s chair, and even her own glasses! 😂

From playing with the doctor’s chair to confidently reading the eye chart while already wearing her glasses, Honey has the doctor completely confused! 🤣👓

And the reason she came to the eye clinic? You won’t believe it! 😂

Watch till the end for Honey’s ultimate reason! 👓😂

If you wear glasses, this one is definitely relatable! ❤️
